messages:
nina: Quick sync — planning a soft-launch canary for text-generation API next Wed (2026-03-25). Goal: smoke SLOs, docs, support handoff, billing paths. Need a triage run and owner list. Can we run a focused checklist this week? @sam @maya @erin @luis :eyes:

sam: I can run a surge sim and synthetic checks. Need expected canary profile: qps=200 steady, 1k/s burst for 30s, avg seq=128. Also need p99 baseline from staging. Will validate alerting hooks to PagerDuty and test escalations.

maya: Eng-runtime: batching knobs OK, fallback to smaller model works. Still want to pin quantized variant for canary to avoid float drift. I'll add a config flag: runtime.model_variant=quanta-v1.

erin: Docs: I'll draft a 'soft-launch playbook' and a short 'What to expect' for customers. Need error table from @maya and SLA matrix from @luis. Will push PR to docs repo and send link here.

luis: Support: building a short runbook for first-line. Escalation path: support -> eng-runtime -> oncall-sre. Need canonical contact list and a sample billing FAQ for possible overages. Also confirm that we have support hours coverage for soft-launch window.

deploy-bot: canary: created deployment canary/text-gen-v3 -> us-west-2, 10% traffic, start=2026-03-25T05:00Z, end=2026-03-25T11:00Z

billing-bot: billing-test: quota metering enabled for canary orgs. Note: overage alerts to billing@redwood.internal. Recommend finance sanity test before traffic ramp.

sam: Quick SLO list proposal:
```
- p50 <= 70ms
- p95 <= 150ms
- p99 <= 250ms
- error rate < 0.1% (5xx + model-fail)
- cost-per-req target -> set baseline in telemetry
```
I'll wire these into synthetic probes and threshold alerts.

maya: On rollback: automatic fallback to text-gen-small if p99 > 350ms or error rate > 0.5%. I'll add fallback policy to routing. Example config:
```
fallback_policy: {
  trigger: { p99_ms: 350, error_pct: 0.5 },
  action: route_to: text-gen-small
}
```

erin: Docs PR live: https://confluence.redwood/soft-launch-playbook (draft). Added sections: what to monitor, customer messaging, SDK snippets, error codes. Still need SLA matrix and billing FAQ.

luis: Support checklist (short):
- Understand SLA tiers
- Know escalation path + runbook link
- Billing FAQ ready
- Template message for customers in canary orgs
I'll own templates and training session.

nina: Action items:
- @sam: surge sims + synthetic probes + PD hooks (due EOD Fri)
- @maya: pin model variant + fallback config + rollback test (due Mon)
- @erin: PR finish + add SLA matrix placeholder (due Mon)
- @luis: support templates + escalation tree (due Mon)
- @billing-bot / finance: schedule billing sanity window (due Thu)

Please reply with :thumbsup: when you accept ownership. We want to run a mini dress rehearsal Tues.

maya: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

erin: :thumbsup: PR link will be updated

luis: :thumbsup: will schedule training

nina: Great — I'll set the calendar and create a short shiproom at T-24h. If any blockers surface, ping here.
